overview: Student reporters present the first Mustang Report of the 2016-2017 school year, covering faculty interviews, school spirit initiatives, and athletic updates. The broadcast also highlights the Medford Strong Motorcycle Run and the upcoming dedication of the Crystal Campbell Peace Garden.

items.title: Faculty Friday: Nick Tucci
items.summary: Assistant Principal Nick Tucci discussed the transition into the new school year, the implementation of the School Brains system, and upcoming student club fairs.

items.title: Stang Gang Spirit Club
items.summary: Club creator Anthony McKillop and member Klein explained how the group fosters school spirit and provides community service opportunities through attendance at sporting events.

items.title: Football Opener and Gym Renovations
items.summary: Athletic Director Robert Maloney and school administrators discussed the season's opening football game and announced the installation of new state-of-the-art equipment in the gymnasium.

items.title: Medford Strong Motorcycle Run
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke and event organizers detailed the scholarship fund benefits of the motorcycle run and announced the upcoming unveiling of the Crystal Campbell Peace Garden.

items.title: Volleyball Season Previews
items.summary: Varsity and junior varsity players discussed their team's family-like bond and their expectations for the season's first matches.
